lesson.title: Review Day: Verbs, Sentences, and Our Story
lesson.subject: punjabi

contentBlocks.text: This week you learned verbs, built sentences, and read your first short story! Today is review day.

Let's review everything: say the four verbs from this week. Build one sentence using 'who + action.' Build one sentence using 'who + what + action.' Read our short story from yesterday one more time. Which part felt easiest this week? Which would you like more practice with?
Great work this week — you built real sentences and read your first story in Punjabi! Next week, we'll keep building on everything you've learned.

objectives: Recall and use all vocabulary and sentence patterns learned this week (four verbs, subject+verb sentences, subject+object+verb sentences)
Re-read this week's short story with growing confidence
materialsNeeded: This week's four worksheets, if kept, for a quick flip-back review
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Go through each part of the week together: verbs, simple sentences, growing sentences, the short story.
2. Ask which part felt easiest and which felt hardest.
3. Move to the worksheet: complete the mixed review.
4. Praise effort and progress across the whole week, not just today's recall.
5. Close by previewing that next week continues building Punjabi sentence and reading skills.
differentiationTips: Struggling: spend extra time on whichever single part felt hardest, rather than requiring equal recall of everything
Ready for more: ask the child to build one brand-new sentence using a verb and word combination not used earlier this week
For a child who enjoys teaching, have them 'teach' this week's story to a family member
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is a review/recall activity — there is no single right/wrong answer. Note which parts of the week the child recalled confidently vs. needed prompting for, to guide next week's pacing.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: A dedicated review day after a full week of new verbs and sentence patterns matches the platform's established pacing pattern (see every K/Grade 1 unit and this course's own established Day-5 pattern) — consolidation before adding more content is essential.
